delta.text: Merge sort preserves equal-key order during left-before-right merging.
In-place quicksort partitions swap non-adjacent elements and can invert equal keys.

segments: Merge sort preserves equal-key order during left-before-right merging. In-place quicksort partitions swap non-adjacent elements and can invert equal keys.

delta.text: Merge sort is stable because equal elements keep their original order when sorted halves merge.
Standard in-place quicksort is unstable because long-range partition swaps can reorder equal keys.
